meta.direction: C · Signal: flat ink-on-paper chrome, no accent hue. Colour appears only where status or data needs a human.
meta.revision: Phase 2b: frontend-design + dataviz audit. Larger type, softened containers, 3-slot validated chart palette, lighter dark surfaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels; the gutter between data surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, chart areas, side nav, top bar. Separated from surface by a border hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, input fields, code and log excerpts.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, menu options and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, pressed (active) state of quiet controls.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, drawers, modals, toasts. Carries shadow-overlay and no border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel edges, row dividers, chart gridline frame. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and checkboxes. 3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token. Also the primary-button fill and the change-marker colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, axis ticks, timestamps, table headers. 5:1 or more on every surface token in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons only (WCAG exempt). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, tooltip).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring offset 2px. 14:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and the tablet nav drawer.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: The one accent: needs action now. Critical, Failed, Down, SLO breach, bad trend past threshold. Text, icons, chart threshold lines. 5:1 or more on every surface token and its own tint in both themes.

tokens.name: status-critical-surface
tokens.usage: Tint behind critical badges, critical rows and the critical banner. Pair with status-critical text.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning, Degraded, At risk, retries. 5.7:1 or more on every surface and its tint in both themes.

tokens.name: status-warning-surface
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning badges and banners, and the degraded-data card state.

tokens.name: status-healthy
tokens.usage: Healthy, Succeeded, Resolved. Outline badges only; healthy is quiet. Teal keeps it off the red–green axis. 5.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: status-healthy-surface
tokens.usage: Only for a Resolved confirmation banner. Never for routine healthy rows.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: No data, Unknown, Stale. Dashed outline. Never show missing data as healthy.

tokens.name: status-unknown-surface
tokens.usage: Tint behind no-data cards and skipped cells.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Running, Queued, Scheduled, informational. Deliberately neutral: in-progress work needs no attention.

tokens.name: status-info-surface
tokens.usage: Tint behind info banners.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical series. chart-1…chart-5 + chart-other validated for colour-blind separation: worst adjacent ΔE2000 across normal, protan, deutan and tritan vision 14.9 light, 16.2 dark (unit-tested). Never encodes status.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series. A fourth or later series folds into chart-other ('Other').

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical series (purple). Added in Phase 2: worst ΔE2000 against every other chart and status colour, across normal, protan, deutan and tritan vision, is 14.2 light and 12.5 dark. Never encodes status.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth categorical series (green). Use only when 5 series are needed; prefer "Other" or a table. Never encodes status (healthy is teal and stays icon + text). Contrast ≥ 7.3:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The 'Other' bucket and comparison (previous-period) series, drawn dashed for lines.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Horizontal only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Memory requests are at 99 % of allocatable.
styles.usage: Default UI and table text. Numbers in tables use tabular figures.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis: the state, the verb, the number that matters.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, axis ticks, field labels, helper text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one decision-driving number in a Metric. Proportional figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Identifiers only: resource names, incident IDs, versions, log lines. Never for numbers or labels.

spacing.note: 4px base. Tight inside tables, generous around primary actions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cell padding (compact), gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding (comfortable), panel header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel header padding, gap inside panel sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters, space above a page's primary action.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel body padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters at 1440 px; separation between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Semantic: controls are slightly softened, containers more so, data grids stay square inside.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Inside data grids: table cells, heatmap cells, chart plot areas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, badges, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Containers: panels, drawers, modals, menus, popovers, toasts.

shadow.note: Only floating layers cast shadow. Never combined with a border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, drawers, modals, toasts on surface-overlay.

size.note: Density: compact for engineering pages, comfortable for Executive and Data Scientist landings.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table rows, compact density (engineering pages).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Table rows, comfortable density (Executive, Data Scientist).

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, compact density.

tokens.name: control-comfortable
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, comfortable density.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Global top bar.

tokens.name: rail-expanded
tokens.usage: Side nav at 1360 px and wider.

tokens.name: rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: Side nav at 1024–1359 px (icons with tooltips).

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Side panel / drawer.
